tools.name: assignVehicle
tools.description:
Assign vehicle
Put a pending or delayed shipment on a vehicle. Replaces any earlier vehicle assignment.
Effects: createLink shipmentVehicle (Shipment → Vehicle); modifyObject Shipment setting status.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The vehicle must be available (not on route or in maintenance). The shipment must fit in the vehicle's remaining capacity. The vehicle must be based at the shipment's origin depot.
Side effects: The vehicle's driver receives the updated route.

tools.name: reassignShipment
tools.description:
Reassign shipment
Move a shipment from one vehicle to another.
Effects: deleteLink shipmentVehicle (Shipment → Vehicle); createLink shipmentVehicle (Shipment → Vehicle).
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The shipment must not be delivered yet. The target vehicle must be available and have room for the shipment.

tools.name: markDelayed
tools.description:
Mark shipment delayed
Effects: modifyObject Shipment setting status, delayReason, eta.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The shipment must not be delivered yet.
Side effects: The customer is notified of the delay and the new ETA on their preferred channel.

newEta.description: Best estimate of the new arrival time.

tools.name: notifyCustomer
tools.description:
Notify customer
Send a short status message about a shipment to its customer.
Effects: modifyObject Shipment setting customerNotified.
Preconditions (the call is rejected otherwise): The message must be between 1 and 300 characters.
Side effects: An email or SMS is sent to the customer, using their preferred channel.
